gripOrHq.title: Vacuum Link
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Security Net Optimization
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a fort when scored. Ice installed on that fort gets +1 strength.

gripOrHq.title: Executive Extraction
gripOrHq.rulesText: Difficulty of Gray Ops agendas is reduced by 1.

gripOrHq.title: Vapor Ops
gripOrHq.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

heapOrArchives.title: City Surveillance
heapOrArchives.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Netwatch Operations Office
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Trace 2 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Pattel’s Virus
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run, put a Pattel counter on a piece of ice that had all its subroutines broken during that run. Each Pattel counter on a piece of ice reduces its strength by 1. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: Streetware Distributor
rig.rulesText: Take [1] from Streetware Distributor, if it has any bits, at the start of each of your turns. A: Put [3] from the bank on Streetware Distributor.

rig.title: The Short Circuit
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

root.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
root.rulesText:
Gain [2] after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

ice.title: Wall of Ice
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Triggerman
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

encounteredIce.title: Triggerman
encounteredIce.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.
